facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic.
facts.quote: Archaeodontosaurus ("ancient-toothed lizard") is a genus of sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic.

facts.statement: Fossils of Archaeodontosaurus were discovered in the Isalo III Formation of Madagascar.
facts.quote: Its fossils were found in the Isalo III Formation of Madagascar.

facts.statement: The type species Archaeodontosaurus descouensi was described in September 2005.
facts.quote: The type species, Archaeodontosaurus descouensi, was described in September 2005.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus is considered a probable sauropod possessing teeth similar to those of prosauropods.
facts.quote: It is a probable sauropod, with prosauropod-like teeth.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus lived approximately 165 million years ago during the Bathonian stage of the Middle Jurassic in what is now Madagascar.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace unos 165 millones durante el Bathoniense, en lo que hoy es Madagascar.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus is known solely from a fossilized jaw containing many teeth with unusual characteristics.
facts.quote: Este dinosaurio es conocido por el fósil de una mandíbula con muchos dientes, con características inusuales.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus was estimated to be between 11 and 13 meters long, weigh approximately 4 to 5 tonnes, and was herbivorous.
facts.quote: Medía entre 11 y 13 metros de longitud, pesaba aproximadamente entre 4 y 5 toneladas y era herbívoro.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus was likely a large quadruped with a long neck, tail, and columnar legs.
facts.quote: probablemente Archaeodontosaurus era un cuadrúpedo grande, con cuello largo y cola y patas columnares.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus was discovered by Eric Buffetaut in 2005 in the Majunga Formation of Isalo III, Madagascar.
facts.quote: Fue descubierto por Eric Buffetaut en 2005 en Isalo III, Formación Majunga, Madagascar.

facts.statement: The genus name means "ancient-toothed lizard" and the specific name honors the collector Didier Descouens.
facts.quote: El nombre significa "lagarto de dientes arqueados", mientras que el epíteto específico está dedicado al naturalista Didier Descouens.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus has posed significant problems for paleontologists regarding sauropod evolution.
facts.quote: Archaeodontosaurus ha planteado muchos problemas para los paleontólogos con respecto a la evolución de los saurópodos.

facts.statement: In Archaeodontosaurus, the typical sauropod evolutionary trend of having primitive jaws but developed teeth was reversed.
facts.quote: En Archaeodontosaurus, sin embargo, estas características estaban revertidas.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence suggests there were at least two different sauropods in the Middle Jurassic of Madagascar.
facts.quote: sugieren que había al menos dos diferentes saurópodos.

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus serves as an indicator of sauropod diversity in the Middle Jurassic of Madagascar.
facts.quote: Este animal también es un indicador de la diversidad de saurópodos en el Jurásico medio de Madagascar

facts.statement: Archaeodontosaurus belongs to the parent group Sauropoda.
Archaeodontosaurus lived between 168.2 and 165.3 million years ago during the Bathonian age.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Bathonian (168.2 to 165.3 million years ago)

rejected.quote: Archaeodontosaurus descouensi... es la única especie conocida del género extinto Archaeodontosaurus de dinosaurio saurópodo basal
